title: Night theme contrast & iconography revamp for onboarding assets
creator: Ivy Zhang
description: Objective: Complete an accessibility-first visual pass on onboarding/quickstart UX assets for the night/dark theme. Scope includes micro-illustrations, iconography, primary onboarding screenshots (first-run flows), and the onboarding quickstart hero in the Console. Goals: 1) Ensure legible contrast across all text/UI layers in dark mode (meet WCAG AA for body text and WCAG AAA where feasible for key labels); 2) Create a consistent set of dark-mode icon variants with accessible stroke/weight and hit-target guidance; 3) Produce updated screenshots and annotated assets for the docs/quickstart pages; 4) Provide a tokens and handoff spec (Figma + code tokens) so frontend can implement without regressions. Constraints: Do not modify core brand colors for light theme. Keep onboarding illustrations visually consistent with the brand while increasing luminance contrast. Work assumes ENG-4210 will land updated color tokens in runtime-1.18; coordinate on variable names. Deliverables: Figma file with dark variants and developer token sheet, annotated screenshot pack in Drive, updated alt-text and ARIA guidance for onboarding flows, and a small implementation PR template for engineering.
acceptance_criteria: All body text in onboarding flows in dark mode must be >= 4.5:1 contrast against background
All primary CTA labels and key form labels in onboarding must be >= 7:1 where possible or have an explicit accessible pattern
Iconography library exported with night-mode SVGs and 1x/2x PNG fallbacks; each icon has minimum stroke 1.5px and explicit color token usage
Figma file includes a tokens page with variable names matching ENG runtime tokens (example: --onboard-bg-dark-900, --onboard-text-muted-60)
Screenshot pack (desktop and mobile widths) captured at 100% zoom, with visible focus rings, reduced-motion variant recorded, and annotated alt-text in the accompanying CSV
Frontend implementation checklist (PR template) completed and referenced in the ticket; engineering signoff from @marco-reyes or delegated reviewer
QA checklist with aXe/Lighthouse runs included and passing thresholds documented in the Drive artifact
